notes: No horizontal scroll/overflow at any width; single quiet column, generous spacing, scannable at 375/393/900px.

Match/tournament names read in full, not truncated in a way that hides key info (e.g. 'National Bank Open presented by Rogers', 'Etappe 7 (fjell): La Voulte-sur-Rhône – Mont Ventoux' wrap cleanly across two lines; Vålerenga–Bodø/Glimt, Sandefjord–KFUM Oslo, Bodø/Glimt–Union Saint-Gilloise, Paris Saint-Germain–Aston Villa all fully legible with both sides shown).

Every event shows a where-to-watch line; all football/golf/cycling channels are Norwegian (TV 2 Play, HBO Max (Sport), Viaplay, NRK, VG+ Sport, Direktesport/Avisa Nordland) — no FOX/ESPN/Sky seen. The one non-Norwegian outlet is 'YouTube (Saint Louis Chess Club)' for an international chess event's official stream, not a Norwegian-rights sport.

The DIREKTE NÅ 'Saint Louis Rapid & Blitz 2026' row (flagged medium on 2026-08-05 for wrapping into 4 cramped lines at 375px because the nowrap channel label squeezed the title) now renders the title on one line at 375px and 393px — that issue looks resolved, not reproduced today.
Times present and sensibly formatted (HH:MM or date ranges for multi-day events); competition/round context shown under each fixture (e.g. 'UEFA Champions League 2026/27 (kvalifisering)').
National flags and club crests render as icons, not broken-image placeholders, across all three widths.
Must-see accent dots appear sparingly, not on every row.
Header (wordmark, date, theme toggle), day headings, and footer (updated-at, calendar link, usage budget) are all intact and aligned at every width.

The floating 'Assistent' (sparkles) button at 375/393px rests over a mid-agenda row (per DESIGN.md § Hjelperen, WP-146 variant D) and does not occlude the last agenda/news row or the footer — consistent with the sanctioned design. At 900px it sits in the empty margin beside the 640px column and overlaps nothing.

Could not assess: real browser tap-target/interaction behavior (only static full-page screenshots were reviewed); could not pixel-zoom into individual crest icons to rule out subtle rendering artifacts.
